summary: Previously, MIME equality compared raw parameter strings, making quoted and unquoted values with identical content unequal. The fix moves equality into src/cmp.rs and compares Value wrappers that decode quoted content. The existing test type_::tests::test_media_type_from_str checks quoted charset="utf-8" against TEXT_PLAIN_UTF_8. Blocked: src/cmp.rs was newly added; its parent has no corresponding region. The old comparison lives in mime-parse/src/lib.rs, and restoring its use requires coordinated changes across files. The imported replacement with a.params() and b.param(name) is adapted code, not a verbatim parent region. No valid single-region verbatim reversal was established.
